title: Unauthenticated API Calls / Missing Authorization
description: API endpoints that do not require authentication or proper authorization allow attackers to call privileged functions or access sensitive data.
businessImpact: High --- unauthenticated access can lead to data disclosure, unauthorized actions, manipulation of business data, and disruption of business operations.
remediation:
- Require strong authentication (OAuth, API keys, or mutual TLS).
- Enforce role-based access control for all requests.
- Implement server-side authorization validation and rate limiting.
- Log and monitor API access for anomalies.
